extensionDescription.message: Find and safely clean low-value Gmail messages locally. Nothing leaves your browser.

heroTitle.message: A cleaner inbox without giving up privacy.

heroCopy.message: Connect Gmail to find low-value messages. Nothing moves until you review and confirm it.

scanDescription.message: Choose how deep to scan. Recent results are reused to protect Gmail quota.

hintAll.message: All scanned messages, grouped by sender.

hintClean.message: Strong cleanup suggestions. Review before moving anything.

hintReview.message: Uncertain messages that need a quick decision from you.

hintKeep.message: Messages that look personal, useful, or from a trusted sender.

selectVisibleCategory.message: Select the visible {category} messages from this sender

openUnsubscribe.message: Open the sender's official unsubscribe link

selectedSender.message: Selected {count} emails across {conversations} Gmail conversations from {sender}.

tryDifferentSender.message: Try a different sender name or email address.

categoryEmpty.message: This scan did not place any messages in this category.

classifyingLocal.message: Messages are being classified locally in this browser.

scanComplete.message: Your inbox stayed untouched. Browse every category below.

nothingChanged.message: Nothing in your inbox was changed.

conversationNote.message: Gmail may display these as {count} conversation rows because Conversation view groups related emails.

movedTrashConversations.message: {count} emails moved to Trash across {conversations} Gmail conversations.

restoredScan.message: Restored your last scan from this device. No rescan needed.

differentAccount.message: The saved scan belongs to another Gmail account. Scan this inbox to create a new one.

settingsDescription.message: Fine-tune local rules. Every setting stays on this device.

languageDescription.message: Follow Chrome automatically or choose a language.

scanDepthDescription.message: Control how much of your inbox is reviewed.

signalsDescription.message: Choose what should influence local scoring.

promotionsDescription.message: Sales, offers, coupons, and unsubscribe-heavy mail

socialDescription.message: Likes, follows, comments, and network updates

trustedDescription.message: Messages matching these addresses always stay in KEEP.

authTokenMissing.message: Google did not return an access token.

rateLimited.message: Gmail is temporarily rate-limiting this account. Wait about a minute, then scan again. Cached messages will not be downloaded twice.

requestFailed.message: The Gmail request failed after several retries.

confirmDisconnect.message: Disconnect this Gmail account? Its saved scan and local message cache will be removed from this device.
